title: Character.AI enters Chapter 11 and seeks a buyer
friendlyTitle: Character.AI is looking for a buyer after filing for bankruptcy
summary: Character.AI has begun a voluntary Chapter 11 process to pursue a court-supervised sale. Its service and paid subscriptions remain active for now, but the company says the platform will be wound down if no workable bid emerges.
friendlySummary: Character.AI has started a Chapter 11 sale process. The service is still working, but it may close if the company cannot find a suitable buyer.
whyItMatters: People who rely on hosted AI companions or store meaningful conversations in them should treat continuity as a business risk, not a guarantee. Character.AI points users to its data-export and account-deletion controls, which are worth reviewing before the sale process concludes.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Online AI services can change or close. If your chats matter to you, check whether you can export them and review your subscription.
